defs.doc:
The metadata and the tensor table of a GGUF file whose first bytes are
`b`, flat. The Ints: the key count, the tensor count, the alignment, the
data offset; then per key its name (length, code points), its types
(count, types) and its values (count, then per value an Int, an index
into the numbers, or a string); then per tensor its name, its dims
(count, dims), its ggml type, its offset in the file and its byte count.
The numbers: every FLOAT32 and FLOAT64 value, in order. Stops when `b`
ends before the tensor table does; the caller retries with more bytes.
